data.one_liner: A map of objects which can be sorted and filtered on both their key and value.
data.what_it_does: Provides SortedMap and FilteredMap classes that hold a map of objects ordered relative to each other. Unlike SplayTreeMap, objects can be ordered on both key and value, and filtered using validation functions and limits.
use_when: You need maps sorted by combinations of keys and values rather than keys alone
You need to filter and limit entries within a map automatically
avoid_when: Standard Dart maps or SplayTreeMap are sufficient for your sorting needs
strengths: Sorts on both keys and values
Supports filtering and size limits via FilteredMap
weaknesses: Limited documentation outside of basic examples
